email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Operational Care Specialist Sea Logistics position at Kuehne+Nagel in Antwerp. With a background in logistics at Katoen Natie and a strong foundation in digital marketing and web development, I bring a unique blend of operational efficiency and technical problem-solving skills.

In my role at Katoen Natie, I maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment, which has prepared me for the demands of sea freight operations. My experience in managing WordPress sites and performing technical audits has honed my attention to detail and structured approach, essential for handling import processes, customs clearance, and documentation.

I am fluent in English, have a B1 level in Dutch, and am based in Zwijndrecht, close to Antwerp. I am eager to contribute to your team and grow within a global leader like Kuehne+Nagel.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how my skills can support your operations.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
